Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown

import pathlib
root=pathlib.Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689749/attempts/31c36fde4a524b3f9529214b2feb9fae/system/state/workspace/programs'); root.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); bg=max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda x: sum(row.count(x) for row in grid))
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]!=bg]
    r0,r1=min(r for r,c in pts),max(r for r,c in pts)
    c0,c1=min(c for r,c in pts),max(c for r,c in pts)
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(r0,r1+1):
      for c in range(c0,c1+1):
        if (r in (r0,r1) or c in (c0,c1)) and grid[r][c]==bg: out[r][c]=2
    return out
'''
(root/'task-8af117af.py').write_text(code)
